summary: Before/after order-entry screenshots show TP/SL prices generated from a 7% TP input using market-appropriate precision for BTC, PUMP, XYZ100, and ETH.

before_after_pairs.label: BTC auto-close TP price precision
before_after_pairs.note: BTC changes from an over-precise decimal TP price to a whole-number TP price.

before_after_pairs.label: PUMP auto-close TP price precision
before_after_pairs.note: PUMP changes from more than six generated price decimals to six decimals.

before_after_pairs.label: XYZ100 auto-close TP price precision
before_after_pairs.note: XYZ100 changes from an over-precise decimal TP price to a whole-number TP price.

before_after_pairs.label: ETH mid-range auto-close TP price precision
before_after_pairs.note: ETH validates the mid-range regression check with one generated price decimal.

videos.note: Videos recorded successfully; screenshots are preferred for concise PR evidence.
